pages.text: With a yerba-filled mate in one hand, the hot kettle in the other and a bombilla in your inventory: right click to brew.$(br2)Each brew gives 4 sips. The yerba washes out a bit each time: the effect lasts less.
After 4 brews the yerba is fully washed and the mate comes back empty (sometimes with used yerba).$(br2)A washed mate can still be brewed once more.
